recipe_version.title: Roasted Whole Branzino with Salmoriglio and Lemon Potatoes
recipe_version.description: Two whole branzino stuffed with lemon, garlic, and oregano and roasted on a bed of crisp-edged sliced potatoes and red onion, then spooned with salmoriglio, the Sicilian lemon, oregano, garlic, and olive oil sauce.

ingredients.name: whole branzino
ingredients.preparation: patted dry, scored 3 times per side

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.note: 1 sliced for the cavities, 2 juiced for the sauce (about 1/3 cup), plus zest

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.note: 3 tbsp potatoes, 2 tbsp fish, 1/3 cup sauce

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 1/4 tsp potatoes, 1 1/2 tsp fish, 1/4 tsp sauce

steps.title: Preheat and prep
steps.body: Turn the oven on to 450 F to preheat with a rack in the middle. Slice the potatoes and onion. Slice 1 lemon and juice and zest the other 2. Slice 2 cloves garlic and grate 2. Pat the fish dry inside and out and score each side 3 times.

steps.title: Roast the potatoes
steps.body: Toss the potatoes and onion with 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 1/4 tsp salt, and the pepper, spread on the sheet pan, and roast in the preheated 450 F oven 20 minutes, until starting to brown.

steps.title: Season the fish and make the salmoriglio
steps.body: While the potatoes roast, season the fish inside and out with 1 1/2 tsp salt, stuff each cavity with lemon slices, sliced garlic, and 2 oregano sprigs, and rub with 2 tbsp olive oil. Whisk the lemon juice and zest, grated garlic, chopped oregano, parsley, chile flakes, 1/4 tsp salt, and 1/3 cup olive oil. Runs inside step 2 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Roast the fish
steps.body: Flip the potatoes, lay the fish on top, and roast 15 to 18 minutes, until the flesh is opaque at the backbone (135 to 140 F) and the potatoes are golden.

steps.title: Fillet and serve
steps.body: Run a knife along the backbone, lift off the top fillets, pull out the spine, and lift the bottom fillets off the skin. Serve with the potatoes and spoon the salmoriglio over everything.
